# CELPIPAce

> Independent online preparation for the CELPIP General test (the English test accepted for Canadian permanent residence and citizenship). Practice every section with instant CLB scoring, take full-length timed mock exams, and get AI feedback on speaking and writing. Not affiliated with Paragon Testing Enterprises.

CELPIPAce is at https://www.celpipace.ca. It is used mainly by people in Canada preparing for Express Entry, PNP, or citizenship, and by applicants abroad — Nigeria, India, the UAE — preparing before they arrive.

## What it does

- **Speaking practice with AI scoring** — 120 prompts across all 8 CELPIP speaking tasks. Record an answer, get a CLB estimate and specific feedback within seconds. This is the section most learners can't practise alone and the one CELPIPAce is best known for.
- **Listening** — 120 practice sets across all 6 parts, with audio.
- **Reading** — 46 practice sets across all 4 parts.
- **Writing** — 40 prompts for both tasks (email and survey response), AI-scored.
- **8 full-length timed mock exams** with a CLB score report per section.
- **AI Study Coach** — reads your practice scores and tells you what to work on this week.
- **Study plan and exam countdown** — set your test date; the plan and reminder emails work backwards from it.
- **CRS score calculator** — see how each CLB level changes Express Entry points.

## Pricing

Free tier with section practice. Premium (weekly, monthly, or annual) unlocks mock exams, full AI scoring, and the coach. No card needed to start.

## Common questions it answers

- How is CELPIP speaking scored, and what does a CLB 9 answer sound like?
- Is CELPIP easier than IELTS for Canadian immigration?
- What CLB level do I need for Express Entry, and how many CRS points is each level worth?
- How long should I prepare for CELPIP?
- What's the difference between CELPIP General and CELPIP General LS?
